QF.id: Cat III AIF Due Diligence and Risk_8

question.text: Short-selling Risk specific to Cat III AIFs includes:

answer.text: Unlimited loss potential (in short positions), stock borrow costs, regulatory restrictions on shorting

explanation.text: The Logic: Short positions have theoretically unlimited loss, plus borrow costs and regulatory restrictions. The Trap: No-risk/narrow descriptions miss short-sale mechanics. Cross-Exam Context: Unique Cat III risk. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Monitor short interest in each position and regulatory risk of short-selling bans.
